sourceReview: The complete 55,563-byte test uses actual UIKit-mounted editor/attachment presentation, real original protected-journal files, original Host/Engine client APIs and a bounded controlled loopback HTTP listener. It does not construct an opaque recovery receipt or replace the protected journal with a mock.

One real original caller operation consumes the controlled file. The fixture observes the exact persisted intent/reservation, then changes only its own journal directory0700->0500 immediately before the actual controlled201. A root test process is refused. The resulting original append/poison path is required before the test proceeds.

The original live catch is held at a real current-lease HTTP check. A duplicate caller claim must fail while that worker remains live. Permission repair preserves the same device/inode; the poisoned original journal still owns its lock and cannot be reopened early.

The presentation lifetime is revoked and drained, the actual owner closes through session revoke-and-drain then journal close, and tracked transport connections reach zero. The same caller intent and retained original creator can then be reconciled under a new session generation using the original Check path. The old generation is inactive; no cross-account result delivery or repeated POST is admitted.

The final assertions require one upload/one201, two metadata reads, one range/digest content read, exact original file, durable verified entry, pending removal and unchanged document body. These are controlled HTTP/client/journal observations, not real Native engine evidence.

The serial fixture bounds connection/request/body/response budgets and start/stop/watchdog time. Every accepted socket remains tracked until cancellation callback; listener cancellation and zero remaining sockets are required for owned file removal.

First thrown failure is preserved across cleanup; XCTest assertion failures also retain fixture files through testRun.totalFailureCount. Missing testRun retains evidence. No other caller/account namespace is recursively removed.

The original renderer listener class is preserved through16 declared literal edits/50 occurrences, verified in both directions using original positions for the deletion. Full render-capture and later assertion-retention corrections are independently reconstructed; previous candidates/failed inspection evidence remain unchanged.

Actual foreground window rendering is checked, JSON and PNG are retained, and visualReview remains PENDING. The system picker is bypassed through its actual model callback and is not claimed as a system-picker or XCUITest interaction.
